therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Antifolate inhibition of thymidylate synthase and other folate-dependent enzymes combined with DNA crosslinking and radiation-induced DNA damage
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Enhanced tumor cell death through synergistic DNA damage and repair inhibition
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Stage IIIA/B Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer patients
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Phase 1: Maximum Tolerated Dose; Phase 2: Overall Survival at 1 Year

results.dose_information: Phase 1 MTD: Pemetrexed 500 mg/m² concurrent, Cisplatin 20 mg/m² Days 1-5 and 22-26 concurrent, then 75 mg/m² consolidation; Radiation 61-65 Gy in 33-35 fractions

context.duration: Treatment with concurrent chemoradiation followed by consolidation chemotherapy, follow-up up to 3 years
